sources.title: pnpm install
keyPoints: A frozen install does not update the lockfile.
It fails when the lockfile is absent or out of sync with manifests.

sources.title: cargo clean — The Cargo Book
keyPoints: Cargo supports an explicit target directory for generated artifacts.
Locked mode fails if dependency resolution would change Cargo.lock.

sources.title: cargo test — The Cargo Book
keyPoints: cargo test compiles and executes unit, integration, and documentation tests.

sources.title: Tests
keyPoints: Tauri mock-runtime tests do not execute native webview libraries.
Platform runners require their native compilation libraries.

sources.title: Mobile Plugin Development
keyPoints: Android plugin commands execute in a TauriPlugin-annotated Kotlin class.
iOS plugin commands execute in a Swift Plugin class through objc entrypoints.
Rust calls the native implementation through run_mobile_plugin.

sources.title: Prerequisites
keyPoints: Android execution requires the Android SDK, NDK, build tools, and Rust Android targets.
iOS execution is macOS-only and requires full Xcode plus iOS Rust targets.

sources.title: Prometheus full 3.0 release plan
keyPoints: The change accepts desktop plus a documented Android/iOS device lane.
The lane must invoke real plugin commands rather than infer execution from compilation.
